rationale: Three lenses ran. No blocking findings after triage. Two blind-lens findings dismissed: Blind-1 assumed a module-level re-init guard that does not exist in the implementation (DOM-state guard is correctly reset by beforeEach); Blind-2 incorrectly assumed react-tooltip v5 has a default global click-outside event to override (it does not — globalCloseEvents defaults to no global events). Two edge-case findings deferred: EC-001 (createRoot idempotency) and EC-002 (test for container-exists path) are pre-existing issues not introduced by this diff. AC-5 coverage gap deferred: spec explicitly designates empty-string suppression as a manual verification item; unit test coverage of the two added props is declared sufficient. Diff is minimal (3 files, 52 insertions, all additive). All pre-commit gates passed: lint, tsc, license headers, secrets scan.
